content.text:
**Finding: deviation (Section 2.1)**

Section 2.1 binds us to a USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment for three years, expressly "without reduction or termination rights" — squarely the playbook walk-away position. It also contradicts Section 9.4 (our 30-day termination for convenience, paying only for conforming Services delivered), Section 7.1 (no undisclosed minimum-use charges), and Section 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges we made no minimum-volume commitment).

Redline (validated, ok:true): replace the commitment with payment for Services ordered under a signed Order Form and usage actually incurred, preserving our termination and reduction rights. Fallback offered in the comment: a commitment limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, with a true-up rather than a penalty.
